description: This file contains multiple functions that set up mock server expectations for forwarding and overriding HTTP requests, including templated responses and delays, using the mockserver-client library.

methods.name: forwardRequestInHTTP
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation to forward an HTTP request to a specified host and port.

methods.name: forwardRequestInHTTPS
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation to forward an HTTPS request to a specified host and port.

methods.name: forwardOverriddenRequest
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation to override the forwarded request's path and headers.

methods.name: forwardOverriddenRequestAndResponse
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation to override both request and response bodies.

methods.name: forwardOverriddenAndModifiedRequest
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation to override request headers, body, path, and query parameters with modifications.

methods.name: forwardOverriddenAndModifiedRequestAndResponse
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation to override request and response with modifications, including headers, cookies, body, and path.

methods.name: forwardOverriddenRequestAndChangeHostAndPort
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation to override request socket address with custom host, port, and scheme.

methods.name: forwardOverriddenRequestWithDelay
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation to delay the response of a forwarded request.

methods.name: javascriptTemplatedForward
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation with a JavaScript template for dynamic forwarding.

methods.name: javascriptTemplatedForwardWithDelay
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation with a JavaScript template and delay for forwarding.

methods.name: velocityTemplatedForward
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation with a Velocity template for dynamic forwarding.
